traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb Alismatales page (read 2026-10-16): Araceae leaves spiral, Tofieldiaceae two-ranked; DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Araceae spiral or two-ranked, Potamogetonaceae two-ranked when alternate. Araceae (about 3,700 of 4,500 spp.) set 'usually'.

traits.life_span.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Araceae, Potamogetonaceae perennial; Hydrocharitaceae and Alismataceae mostly perennial with a few annuals.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence usually scapose; Araceae spadix on a scape ending each sympodial unit (we read terminal); DELTA Alismataceae: on scapes. Axillary in Potamogetonaceae and Hydrocharitaceae (overridden).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb (read 2026-10-16): flowers undistinguished and radial through most families; every family that states symmetry is actinomorphic (Hydrocharitaceae rarely zygomorphic).

traits.hypanthium.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): no floral cup in Araceae, Potamogetonaceae, Alismataceae; Hydrocharitaceae sometimes have a perianth tube above the inferior ovary (not overridden; see conflicts).
